beats.text: Training a custom model head for every single task is a massive, bottlenecked waste of compute.
beats.visual_focus: A forest of disconnected, task-specific miniature neural networks collapsing into rubble.

visual_blueprint.title: THE FINE-TUNING DEBT
visual_blueprint.sub: Individual heads per task create a fragmented model architecture

beats.text: We force-feed thousands of examples into models, treating deep learning like a manual data-labeling treadmill for every minor adjustment.
beats.visual_focus: A conveyor belt of labeled data packets hitting a massive, unmoving wall of static weights.

visual_blueprint.title: THE LABELING BOTTLENECK
visual_blueprint.sub: Fine-tuning requires massive labeled datasets for every incremental task

beats.text: Scaling the architecture to 175 billion parameters allows the model to absorb task patterns directly from raw, unlabelled text sequences.
beats.visual_focus: A massive parameter cloud expanding to encompass scattered data points without needing structural changes.

beats.text: By framing every task as an autoregressive completion, we bypass gradient updates entirely, using English prompts as universal instruction vectors.
beats.visual_focus: Text prompts refracting through the model like light through a prism to generate correct next-token outputs.
